name: Paseo Powerpack
description: Paseo Powerpack (formerly File Inspector & Finder Reveal): 28+ workbench & multi-agent enhancements including Multi-Document Preview & Compare (PDF/Office/EPUB/iWork), Task Decisions Queue (⌃⌘D), Schedule Runs History (⌘⇧H), Subagent Tree (⌘⇧B), Project Quick Switcher (⌘J), Zero-Popup Inline Rename (F2), Smart Dual-MIME Clipboard Copy (⌘C), Quote Reply, Model Quick Switch (⌘/), Custom STT Models, and Finder Reveal.
